name: idle-notify
description: Sends a desktop notification, and optionally a chime, when Claude has been waiting for you for a delay you choose

delaySeconds.title: Delay (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: How long Claude waits for you, after a turn ends or while it asks a question, before the notification is sent.

sound.title: Play a chime
sound.description: Play a short chime with the notification (macOS).
